note: Literature on PLAA-related neurodevelopmental disorder consistently identifies thin corpus callosum, progressive cerebral and cerebellar atrophy, and delayed myelination as cardinal neuroimaging features.

evidence.text: Neuroimaging findings in patients with PLAA mutations included a thin corpus callosum, delayed myelination, and progressive cerebellar and cerebral atrophy alongside progressive microcephaly.
